findings.rule: every move says what, how, and why
findings.problem: The voice jumps from 'X is sixty' to '60 sin(πt/3) = 60' without saying where the left side comes from. The line x = 60 sin(πt/3) has scrolled far off the top, so a student may not see that the 60 is being put into it.
findings.fix: Say 'Put X equals sixty into X equals sixty sine pi T over three' as e1 is written. A short 'x = 60' note under e1 would also help.

findings.rule: the part talked about is lit
findings.problem: Lighting sw-amp turns both 60 and −60 orange, but the voice names only the highest point, sixty.
findings.fix: Light only the 60 at the top of the graph on 'graph's highest point', and leave −60 unlit.
